updated_paragraphs.old: 面向ISO New England（ISO-NE）控制区的短期运行分析，本文设计并实现基于TensorFlow的负荷、电价和光伏预测系统。负荷与电价训练数据覆盖2017年1月1日01:00至2026年8月1日00:00，PV v2训练数据覆盖2025年2月1日至2026年9月10日。三个独立的TensorFlow/Keras模型分别使用168小时历史信息预测未来24小时负荷、使用168小时历史信息输出未来24小时电价P10/P50/P90分位，以及使用96小时历史信息和天气预报预测未来24小时八区汇总的estimated BTM PV。FastAPI、React和MySQL实现本地数据获取、推理、持久化与历史分析。在线负荷和电价以小时结束时间标记，光伏以小时开始时间标记；未结束的小时不记为完整实测。在线流程按负荷、电价、光伏分别报告数据状态，短时缺数只作有来源记录的估计输入，不进入真实值与误差统计。固定测试集上，负荷模型MAE为305.40 MW、RMSE为476.14 MW、MAPE为1.922%、R²为0.97739；电价模型P50 MAE为13.266 USD/MWh，P10—P90覆盖率为66.93%；PV v2全时段MAE为236.1834 MW，白天WAPE为17.0532%。负荷与电价固定测试使用事后可得的SMD温度、露点观测，不等同于严格在线天气预报条件；在线缺数补值的预测精度也尚未独立验证。系统已形成可在本机运行的三类预测原型，但电价区间校准、峰值负荷预测和真实联网条件下的长期稳定性仍需改进。
updated_paragraphs.new: 面向ISO New England（ISO-NE）控制区的短期运行分析，本文设计并实现基于TensorFlow的智能电网负荷预测系统，并扩展电价分位预测与分布式光伏预测。三个独立模型分别以168小时负荷历史、168小时电价历史和96小时光伏历史为输入，结合未来天气与日历特征，输出未来24小时结果。系统采用React、TypeScript、FastAPI与MySQL，在Windows本地运行。在线流程统一使用美国东部时区，区分小时开始与小时结束标签；通过启动预加载、共享请求和有效缓存恢复改善首次数据展示，并分别报告三个任务的数据状态。系统新增在线负荷提前量分组、实际输入归档及24步离线重放，使生成时间、数据来源和评价对象可以追溯。固定测试集上，负荷MAE为305.40 MW、RMSE为476.14 MW、MAPE为1.922%、R²为0.97739；电价P50 MAE为13.266 USD/MWh，P10—P90覆盖率为66.93%；光伏全时段MAE为236.1834 MW，白天WAPE为17.0532%。光伏指标以ISO-NE估算出力为参考。负荷和电价固定测试使用事后气象，不能直接代表严格在线预报精度；估计输入不作为真实标签。现有模型权重保持不变，新增电价区间校准候选未通过验证。阶段验收确认本地启动、重启缓存、真实接口与浏览器交互可用，长期稳定性、极端场景精度和夏令时完整日处理仍有待验证。

updated_paragraphs.old: This thesis designs and implements a local TensorFlow-based system for short-term load, electricity-price, and photovoltaic (PV) forecasting in the ISO New England (ISO-NE) control area. The load and price training data cover 1 January 2017 01:00 to 1 August 2026 00:00, and the PV v2 training data cover 1 February 2025 to 10 September 2026. Three independent TensorFlow/Keras models forecast 24 hours of load from a 168-hour history, output 24 hours of P10/P50/P90 price quantiles from a 168-hour history, and forecast aggregated estimated behind-the-meter PV from a 96-hour history and weather features. FastAPI, React, and MySQL support local acquisition, inference, persistence, and historical analysis. Online load and price targets are labeled by hour end, whereas PV inputs are labeled by hour start. An unfinished hour is never treated as a complete observation. The online pipeline reports load, price, and PV availability separately; bounded estimates for short input gaps retain their provenance and are excluded from actual-value and error statistics. On the fixed test sets, the load model obtains an MAE of 305.40 MW, an RMSE of 476.14 MW, a MAPE of 1.922%, and an R² of 0.97739. The price model obtains a P50 MAE of 13.266 USD/MWh and a P10-P90 coverage of 66.93%. PV v2 obtains an all-period MAE of 236.1834 MW and a daytime WAPE of 17.0532%. The fixed load and price tests use retrospective SMD temperature and dew-point observations, not archived online forecasts; the forecasting accuracy of the short-gap input fallback has not been independently validated. The result is a runnable local prototype, while price-interval calibration, peak-load prediction, and long-term reliability under live network conditions remain open work.
updated_paragraphs.new: This thesis develops a TensorFlow-based load forecasting system for the ISO New England (ISO-NE) control area, with additional electricity-price quantiles and distributed photovoltaic (PV) forecasts. Three independent models combine historical sequences and future weather and calendar features to forecast 24 hours ahead. Load and price use 168-hour histories; PV uses a 96-hour history. React, TypeScript, FastAPI, and MySQL support local operation on Windows. The online pipeline uses the America/New_York time zone and distinguishes hour-start PV labels from hour-ending load and price labels. Startup preloading, shared requests, and validated cache restoration improve initial data availability. Each task reports its own availability and input quality. New features include lead-time groups for online load errors, actual-input archives, and offline replay of all 24 forecast steps. On the fixed test sets, load MAE is 305.40 MW, RMSE is 476.14 MW, MAPE is 1.922%, and R² is 0.97739. Price P50 MAE is 13.266 USD/MWh, with P10–P90 coverage of 66.93%. PV all-period MAE is 236.1834 MW and daytime WAPE is 17.0532%, relative to ISO-NE estimated behind-the-meter PV. Fixed load and price tests use retrospective weather observations and do not establish strict online forecast accuracy. Estimated inputs are excluded from reference labels. Production weights remain unchanged, and two price-interval calibration candidates failed validation. Staged acceptance records confirm local startup, restart recovery, live API access, and browser interaction. Long-term reliability, extreme-event accuracy, and complete daylight-saving-day handling require further evaluation.
